name: Cayman Islands
summary: Claimed by Spain, settled from Jamaica, retained by Britain.
notes: The chart does not invent a Taíno state for the Caymans. Archaeological and historical accounts do not establish a permanent population at European contact.

events.title: Columbus sights the sister islands
events.detail: Cayman Brac and Little Cayman were named Las Tortugas; Spain did not settle them.
events.qualification: A European claim; it does not establish island-wide administration or extinguish Indigenous rights.

events.title: Early English settlements
events.detail: Settlements on the sister islands preceded Spain’s recognition of English possession.
events.uncertainty: These settlements were interrupted by raids; durable occupation grew gradually.

events.title: English possession recognized
events.detail: The Treaty of Madrid recognized the English Caribbean possessions held with Jamaica.

events.title: Cayman remains British
events.detail: As Jamaica became independent, the Caymans remained a British dependency.
